title: Use Techpack Mama for edits and quality checks
summary: Use QC to find details that need checking. We show how to read the findings, fix an issue, and approve edits from Techpack Mama.
body_markdown:
Click Review design details in the right panel to open Quality check. Answer the questions and click Continue. Click Review, then Review evidence to see what Mama found. Use View page to go to the issue. Fix it, save your changes, then click Recheck. If Mama suggests an edit, read the edit card and click Apply edit to approve it.


[Watch on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9A8WWRucoEU)


## Before you start


- Open the tech pack you want to check.
- Have your garment details ready so you can answer the questions and check what Mama finds.


## How to do it


1.


### Open Quality check


Find Techpack Mama in the right panel and click Review design details. Answer the questions, then click Continue.


2.


### Read the finding


Click Review, then Review evidence to see what Mama found. Click View page to go to that part of the tech pack.


3.


### Fix, save and recheck


You can fix the issue yourself in the editor. Save your changes before clicking Recheck so QC checks the updated saved version.


4.


### Ask Mama for a change


Tell Mama what you want to fix. Mama shows an edit card and waits for your approval before making the change.


5.


### Approve the edit


Read the edit card, then click Apply edit if you want to make the change. Check the changed fields afterward. Save before you run Recheck again.


## An example


### Check a fabric that does not match


QC finds a red fabric entry in the BOM that does not match what was asked for. Read the evidence and click View page to see the BOM. You can fix it yourself or ask Mama to change it.


## Things to check


- Read the evidence and look at the page before you decide what to change.
- Save your changes before clicking Recheck. QC checks the saved version.
- Mama waits for you to click Apply edit. Read the edit card first, then check the changed fields.
- QC helps you spot issues. Your team still needs to check construction, fit, grading and samples.


## A few common questions


Will Mama make these edits without asking me?


No. Mama shows an edit card and waits for your approval. Click Apply edit to make the changes shown on the card.


When should I click Recheck?


Fix the issue and save your changes first. Then click Recheck to check the updated saved version.


Can I fix the issues myself?


Yes. Read the finding and evidence, then click View page to see the issue. You can make the change in the editor.


Do I still need to check fit and samples?


Yes. QC helps you spot issues, but your team still needs to check fit, construction, grading and samples.


## Video transcript


Read the transcript


Today I’m going to show you Techpack Mama and its quality-checking system inside AI Tech Packs. Techpack Mama is in the right panel. Click Review design details to open Quality check. The QC system asks a few questions. Answer them, then click Continue. Techpack Mama found some issues. For example, the BOM red fabric does not match. Click Review, then Review evidence to read what Mama found. It found a red fabric entry in the BOM. Click View page to jump to the BOM page, where we can see the red fabric entry. It does not match the requirement. You can use this report to fix the issue yourself. As you make edits, go back to Mama’s QC system and click Recheck to run the check again. Now I’ll show how to use Mama to make changes. When you ask Mama to change something, you get an edit card to approve the edits. Mama waits for your permission before editing. Click Apply edit. You can see the changed fields here.
